report_name: Cisco Patches High-Severity RCE Flaw in UCS Central Software

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-76506
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco UCS Central Software caused by insufficient input validation. An authenticated, remote attacker with low privileges could send a specially crafted HTTP request to achieve remote code execution (RCE) on the underlying operating system.
affected_products: Cisco UCS Central Software releases prior to 2.1(2c)

indicators.name: Suspicious Shell Spawned by Cisco UCS Web Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Shell Spawned by Cisco UCS Web Server
id: 7b8e5d4a-1c2b-4f6e-8d9a-0b1c2d3e4f5a
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the execution of common shells or scripting interpreters by a web server user account on a Cisco UCS Central appliance.
  This could indicate exploitation of a remote code execution vulnerability, such as CVE-2026-76506.
references:
  - https://breachroad.com/en/blog/cisco-ucs-central-cve-2026-76506-rce/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    User:
      - 'httpd'
      - 'www-data'
      - 'nginx'
      # Add other potential web server users for Cisco appliances
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/python'
      - '/perl'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts or applications that run under the web server user context.
indicators.description: Detects unexpected shell processes (sh, bash, python, perl) being executed by the web service account on a Cisco UCS Central appliance, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-76506.

relationships.source_name: Suspicious Shell Spawned by Cisco UCS Web Server
